title: 第028章 古卷藏锋寻琴韵，寒村踏影战魔渊
content_zh:
“韩绪，我再问你一句话，你要是肯将义盟‘交’出來，我可以饶你一命。”李海亮冷声道。

    有的网友更是搞怪，发起了一条寻找飞鱼哥的消息，要将飞鱼哥人肉出来，一定要将这种精神发扬起来。

    “多谢姑娘的救命之恩。”他感激地说道，边说还边艰难地起身向她道谢。

    从医生那里哈顺格日丽知道了一些心脏病的知识。她知道爸爸这次抢救过来都是奇迹了，如果再次发病救过来的希望就不大了。

    “这个老夫就不知了，秦道友，古话说的好，不做亏心事，莫怕鬼敲门。这件事情总有水落石出的一天，我玄真可以保证，武当在没查清楚谣言之前，绝不与你为难。”玄真说道。

    “那个，不知仙翁能否探得出来，苏……苏宫主他到底为我度入了多少真气呢？这样对他的身体会有碍吗？”虽然这样问有点难为情，但她最终还是问了出口。

    让淳于代天等核心人物恼火的是，那个郎姓修士毫无踪影，无论他们派出多少密探，都在浩瀚大陆内找不到此人的任何蛛丝马迹，这让那些修真总联盟核心人物大为恼怒万分的同时也震惊无比。

    “哼，砍刀，俗话说狗急了还跳墙呢！你也知道我现在有点困难，岸徽的地盘很紧张，人被逼急了，什么也做的出吧”骆驼冷冷的哼了声，语气加重了几分。

    “放心吧，去家里等着我，我现在就去救他们”韩羽拍了拍船长的肩膀，安慰道。

    见轩辕笑那副恶心表情，看到的妖族不禁眼角抽蓄，很是无言，不由自主的便在心里把人类丑化，有些习惯的认为，人类就是这么恶心。

    “大人，正是兽元果！”邱虎露出了一丝谄媚的笑容，对着梦风点头道。
content_en:
"Han Xu, let me ask you one more thing. If you are willing to 'hand over' the Yi Alliance, I can spare your life." Li Hailiang said coldly.

    Some netizens were even more weird and launched a message to find Brother Feiyu. If they want to kill Brother Feiyu, they must carry forward this spirit.

    "Thank you girl for saving your life." He said gratefully, and stood up with difficulty to thank her.

    Hasungerli learned some knowledge about heart disease from the doctor. She knew that it was a miracle that her father was rescued this time. If he got sick again, there would be little hope of saving him.

    "I don't know about this. Fellow Daoist Qin, as the old saying goes, if you don't do anything wrong, don't be afraid of ghosts knocking on the door. This matter will eventually come to light. I, Xuanzhen, can guarantee that Wudang will never embarrass you before the rumors are investigated." Xuanzhen said.

    "Um, I wonder if the Immortal can find out, Su... How much Qi did Palace Master Su absorb for me? Will this be harmful to his body?" Although it was a bit embarrassing to ask, she finally asked.

    What annoyed Chunyu Daitian and other core figures was that there was no trace of the monk named Lang. No matter how many spies they sent, they could not find any trace of this person in the vast continent. This made the core figures of the Cultivation Alliance extremely angry and shocked at the same time.

    "Huh, machete, as the saying goes, a dog will jump over the wall when it's anxious! You also know that I'm in a bit of trouble now. An Hui's territory is very tense. If a person is forced to become anxious, he can't do anything." Luotuo snorted coldly, his tone a little more serious.

    "Don't worry, go home and wait for me. I'll go rescue them now." Han Yu patted the captain on the shoulder and consoled him.

    Seeing Xuanyuan Xiao's disgusting expression, the monster clan couldn't help but twitching in the corners of their eyes. They were very speechless and couldn't help but vilify humans in their hearts. Some people are accustomed to thinking that humans are so disgusting.

    "Sir, it's the Beast Yuan Fruit!" Qiu Hu showed a flattering smile and nodded to Mengfeng.
title_en: Chapter 028 The ancient scroll hides the edge to find the rhyme of the piano, and Hancun steps into the shadow to fight against the devil.
